svg.title: Starmux — Many AI clients, many self-hosted computers
svg.desc: Editable vector architecture diagram with vectorized official WorkBuddy logo showing MCP-capable AI clients connected over Direct HTTPS or Secure Tunnel to Starmux instances installed on macOS, Windows, and Linux machines.

g.text: Use Direct HTTPS or Secure Tunnel to connect remote AI clients to the real tools on your own machines.

g.title: Client, transport and gateway connection routes

g.text: The real tools on your machines

g.aria-label: WorkBuddy icon vectorized from the uploaded official PNG

g.text: Your gateways. Your machines. Your data.
Work with your files, terminal, Git and services
Direct HTTPS avoids a managed relay. Secure Tunnel uses OpenAI forwarding. Multi-computer orchestration is a deployment pattern, not a single built-in unified control plane.
